note: Status of every water system in Endur'O's mWater group (piped_systems.csv). A piped system joins the managed portfolio only when its rehabilitation works are complete AND its post-rehabilitation water-quality tests are done (Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026). tools/rebuild_piped_wq.py applies it: a system whose works_complete date is set and which has a result dated after it is managed, and only those post-rehabilitation results count; a result dated on or before works completion is baseline and never counts. The build fails if the extract holds a system id that is not listed here. status: managed / in_process / not_managed. admitted_by_decision records a system managed by decision rather than by the rule; the rule still applies to every other system. confirmed: false marks a status inferred here that Endur'O should confirm.
source: Endur'O water systems from mWater (group c305b9b8, extract piped_systems.csv, pulled 2026-09-25); the four Moramanga systems identified from forms 3ef4385a and a34cb66b; status and join rule per Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026.

1125843376.name: Kiosk
1125843376.basis: The first Antananarivo smart-tap kiosk, admitted to the managed portfolio by decision (Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026): operational with SaniTap/Curtech meters, its data in Zoho. Registered in mWater through the Endur'O System form (44044e27, response b0b01aa0, draft) and the Distribution Point form (8a3af50c, response 840ae830, draft): one dispensing point, water point 1125843383, with one outlet fitted with a smart tap, installed 7 Sep 2026 and commissioned 14 Sep 2026. The join rule still applies to every other piped system; this one is admitted by decision, and no water-quality test is yet on record for it.
1125843376.operational_since_basis: Date of commissioning (first service to users), question 1.9 of the Distribution Point registration 840ae8302d4b4c55b456fa31e337a1b9 (draft), mWater. The first real dispense in Zoho (earliest non-test transaction; SK01 and SK02 are test records, SK03 the live shopkeeper) could not be read: the Curtech endpoints getTransactions and getShopkeepers are not reachable from this build.
